jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE ROLE 0G is hiring its first dedicated DevOps engineer to own our cloud platform end to end: infrastructure, deployments, networking, security hygiene and cost. Today that work is spread across several developers. Our platform runs on five providers: Google Cloud, Alibaba Cloud, AWS, Cloudflare and Vercel. It includes: - Validator, seed, RPC, and archive nodes for our mainnet and testnet - Confidential-computing (TEE) workloads, GPU machines and storage nodes - Kubernetes clusters and managed databases - A global RPC load balancer at the edge, and our web apps All together, that is more than 200 virtual machines. You will be the person who knows what runs where, why it runs there, and what it costs. WHAT YOU'LL OWN You own the platform, from the network edge to the bill. - Cloud operations: provisioning, upgrades, capacity and the full resource lifecycle on Google Cloud, Alibaba Cloud and AWS. That includes rightsizing and releasing what nobody uses. - Kubernetes: run, upgrade and scale our clusters. Keep them on supported versions and design node pools, autoscaling and Spot capacity. - Blockchain node fleet: operate validator, sentry, seed, RPC and archive nodes, including peering topology, snapshots, sync and client upgrades. - Networking and edge: VPC design, load balancers, DNS, Cloudflare Workers, Tunnels and WAF, and keeping internet egress deliberate and cheap. - Infrastructure as code and CI/CD: every environment defined in Terraform or Pulumi. You design and run CI/CD on Jenkins or an equivalent such as GitHub Actions or GitLab CI, covering builds, tests, security scans and releases from commit to production, with no manual steps. - Observability and on-call: metrics, logs, alerts and dashboards, including control of metric cardinality. You also run incident response and write the postmortems. - Security and access: least-privilege IAM across every provider, secrets management, and no databases or admin ports open to the internet. - Cost management: billing exports, budgets and alerts, tagging, a monthly cost review and commitment planning. - Developer enablement: templates, preview environments, documentation and support for the engineers who ship on the platform. OUR STACK Kubernetes: GKE, EKS, Helm, Ingress and Gateway API, autoscaling, RBAC, network policies Networking: TCP/IP, subnets and CIDR, routing, NAT, L4 and L7 load balancers, DNS, TLS, firewalls, VPC peering Google Cloud: Compute Engine, GKE, Cloud SQL, Cloud Run, IAM, Cloud Monitoring, billing export to BigQuery Infrastructure as code: Terraform, Pulumi CI/CD and containers: Jenkins or an equivalent (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI), Argo CD, Docker and BuildKit, container registries Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, Cloud Monitoring, CloudWatch, Alibaba CloudMonitor Linux: Systems administration, systemd, disks and filesystems, performance debugging Alibaba Cloud: ECS, VPC, NLB and ALB, ESSD disks, RDS, PolarDB, SAE, Cloud Firewall AWS: EC2, EKS, RDS, ALB and NLB, Route 53, S3, Organizations Cloudflare: DNS, Workers, Tunnels, WAF and rate limiting, Zero Trust Databases (operations): PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, managed Kafka Blockchain nodes: CometBFT-based chains, reth and other EVM clients, P2P networking Vercel: Projects, builds, ISR, team access Confidential computing: Intel TDX virtual machines on Google Cloud and Alibaba Cloud MUST-HAVES - We want 5+ years in DevOps, SRE or platform roles, including 3+ years running production Kubernetes and owning CI/CD pipelines. Kubernetes, in depth - Upgrading control planes and node pools with no downtime, and keeping clusters on supported versions. - Scheduling: requests and limits, affinity, taints and tolerations, priority, and eviction under node pressure. - Autoscaling with the HPA, cluster autoscaler or Karpenter, plus Spot or preemptible node pools for non-critical work. - Networking inside the cluster: CNI, Services, Ingress or Gateway API, network policies, and DNS within the cluster. - Security: RBAC, Pod Security, workload identity, and secrets that never sit in plain environment variables. - Stateful workloads: StatefulSets, persistent volumes and CSI drivers, and backup and restore. - Packaging and delivery with Helm or Kustomize, ideally through GitOps with Argo CD or Flux. - Debugging a failing pod, node or rollout from events, logs and metrics. CI/CD, in depth - Pipeline design: you have built and run production CI/CD on Jenkins or an equivalent (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, CircleCI, Tekton). Pipelines are defined as code in a Jenkinsfile or workflow YAML, with shared libraries and reusable templates. - CI platform operations: running Jenkins controllers with ephemeral agents on Kubernetes, or self-hosted runners. That includes plugin and version upgrades, credential handling, and scaling build capacity. - Build pipelines: multi-service and monorepo builds with caching and parallel stages, and versioned artifacts. Container images built with Docker, BuildKit or Kaniko, including multi-architecture images, image scanning, SBOMs and signing. - Deployment pipelines: promotion from dev to staging to production with approvals and quality gates, plus blue-green, canary and fast rollback. GitOps with Argo CD or Flux, and database migrations as part of a release. - Infrastructure pipelines: Terraform or Pulumi plan and apply from CI, with policy checks and drift detection. - Pipeline security: short-lived credentials through OIDC federation or a secrets vault instead of long-lived keys, least-privilege deploy roles, and protected branches. - Release engineering for our chain: building and publishing node binaries and images, and coordinating rolling upgrades across validator and RPC fleets. - Delivery health: you track build time, build cost, flaky tests and DORA metrics (deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate, time to restore), and you cut wasted builds with ignore rules and caching. Networking fundamentals - TCP/IP, subnetting and CIDR, routing, NAT, and the difference between L4 and L7 load balancing. - DNS, TLS and certificates, firewalls and security groups. - Private connectivity: VPC design, peering, private endpoints, and keeping internal traffic off public IPs. - Troubleshooting with dig, curl, mtr and tcpdump, and understanding what internet egress costs. Also required - Production experience on at least two of Google Cloud, AWS and Alibaba Cloud, and willingness to learn the third quickly. - Terraform or Pulumi in production, plus scripting in Bash and in Python or Go. - A track record of cutting a cloud bill with data, through rightsizing, cleanup or commitments. - A security-first habit with production credentials, and clear written communication. NICE TO HAVE - Running blockchain nodes in production, such as CometBFT validators and sentries, EVM archive or RPC nodes, and snapshot pipelines. - Cloudflare Workers, Tunnels and Zero Trust at scale. - Alibaba Cloud on the international site, including its billing and support model. - Confidential computing (Intel TDX) and GPU workloads. - CKA or CKS certification, a FinOps certification, or experience moving a team between CI systems, such as Jenkins to GitHub Actions. - Go or Rust, enough to read and patch the services you operate. WHAT WE OFFER - Purpose: The opportunity to contribute to making AI a public good - Growth: A self-directed environment where you can take initiative to shape your role and career - Compensation: Market-competitive compensation including, for most roles, exposure to pre-launch tokens In addition, 0G Labs is committed to the health and well being of all of our team members. To that end, we provide reimbursements towards a holistic set of experiences and courses: - Core self: Transcendental Meditation - Mind: Landmark Education https://www.landmarkworldwide.com - Emotion: Art of Communication - Presence: Speech Coach - Body: Fitness, gym and exercise memberships/classes

jobs.description_text: About Abound We’re redefining consumer lending in the UK, and beyond. Using advanced AI and Open Banking data, we make fair, affordable personal finance available to more people. While traditional lenders rely almost entirely on credit scores, we look at the full financial picture - how much you spend, and what you can afford to repay to build a deeper, more accurate understanding of each customer's unique financial situation. And we've shown it works at scale. We’ve issued over £1.3bn in loans directly to customers while delivering market-leading credit performance - for every 10 defaults the industry expects, we see only 3. We also reached profitability just 2.5 years after launch. Backed by £2bn+ of funding from top-tier investors including Citi, GSR Ventures, and Deutsche Bank, we’re recognised as one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs (Sifted, CNBC). Now, we’re expanding into new markets and product lines - and we’re looking for ambitious people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and grow with us. We're looking for an experienced individual to join us in the role of Senior Software Engineer. This position requires enthusiasm for exploring and understanding new business areas. We maintain a culture of ownership and value engineers that are excited about the business and are willing to work alongside stakeholders to continually improve business processes and customer experience. We offer a broad range of opportunities across platform engineering, B2B customer integration, conversion optimisation and business process automation. At Abound, you will work on the best-in-class open-banking decision making platform, and learn how to operate with low-latency, at scale. Candidates must have had experience working directly with internal stakeholders to establish requirements, designing technical solutions, and owning the delivery of significant functionality, ideally having worked with peers of different levels to complete projects collaboratively. Fluency in both Chinese and English is essential to facilitate seamless communication and collaboration. Our technology stack: Python (including FastAPI, OpenTelemetry, procrastinate, SQLAlchemy, Uvicorn), Postgres, MySQL, Liquibase, Retool, Docker, AWS Who you are: - Seven or more years professional experience in software engineering - Proven experience leading the development of significant new functionality - Proficiency in writing well-structured async Python code with type hints and unit tests - Experience maintaining codebases for business-critical systems - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills - Effective communication and collaboration skills - Proficiency in Git for version control - Basic knowledge of cloud infrastructure with experience working with at least one of AWS, GCP, or Azure - Strong SQL skills for efficient data management and retrieval - Knowledge of lending products and business processes will be a major advantage - Fluency in both Chinese and English What you'll be doing: - Develop new features backend services that could span any part of the lending lifecycle, from finding and onboarding new customers, to helping underwriters asses their affordability, all the way through to paying out and then collecting a loan - Participate in the entire SDLC, helping to design changes, review code, build tests, and coordinate deployments - Own a part of the platform and be responsible for the smooth operation of associated business processes, and their KPIs. - Collaborate closely with colleagues in Product and Design as well as users (both internal and external) to understand, challenge, and refine requirements - Provide second-line support within business hours, helping to troubleshoot and resolve any system issues that impact our customers - Supporting junior engineers through PRs and pairing - Apply strong SQL skills to troubleshoot and improve the performance of data management and retrieval across our Postgres databases

jobs.description_text: About BJAK The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name. Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you. The Role We are looking for Mobile application developer to build the native Android experience for BJAK's AI Finance Agent. This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers. What You'll Own - Build and ship Android features using Kotlin. - Create clean mobile flows for insurance, payments, claims, renewals and financial services. - Work with product and design to simplify complex user journeys. - Integrate backend APIs and ensure mobile flows are stable, secure and reliable. - Improve app performance, crash rate, loading states, responsiveness and memory usage. - Use analytics, user behaviour and production issues to improve the product. - Build AI-assisted mobile experiences only where they genuinely improve the user journey. What We're Looking For - 3+ years of Android development experience using Kotlin. - Strong Android fundamentals and experience shipping production apps. - Good knowledge of Jetpack, Coroutines, Flow and modern Android architecture. - Strong sense of mobile UX, usability, edge cases and user flows. - Experience integrating REST APIs and debugging production issues. - Fast execution, high ownership and strong attention to product quality. - App links, GitHub, screenshots or examples of shipped work are a strong advantage. Tech Stack - Kotlin - Jetpack Compose - Android SDK - Coroutines & Flow - SQL / NoSQL - TensorFlow Lite (on-device inference) The Kind of Builder We Want - Thinks in user journeys, not just screens. - Cares about making complex financial products feel simple. - Moves fast without creating messy code. - Notices UX, performance and reliability issues before users complain. - Honest about what they personally built, what was team-owned and what impact they can or cannot claim. This Role Is Not For - Engineers who only want fully defined tickets. - Developers who build screens without caring about user experience. - People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance. - Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment. - People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution. Location This role is remote, but candidates must be based in China. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in China. Language English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required. Interview Process Our process is designed to move fast: 1. Online assessment or practical task 2. Role-specific interview 3. CEO / final round For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.description_text: ABOUT BJAK The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name. Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia. Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you. THE ROLE We are looking for applied AI engineers to build AI-native systems for BJAK's AI Neobank app. This is not a research-only role. We need builders who can use AI to automate real workflows, improve products, reduce manual work and make financial services easier for users and teams. WHAT YOU WILL BUILD - Build AI agents, workflows, tools and automations that solve real customer, product and operations problems. - Apply LLMs, retrieval, tool calling, evaluations, guardrails and automation to practical financial workflows. - Create AI-assisted experiences for onboarding, support, KYC, risk review, CRM, operations, document handling and product intelligence. - Work with product and engineering teams to identify what is worth building, then build it quickly and improve it in production. - Design around real constraints: accuracy, hallucination risk, latency, cost, security, compliance and user trust. - Turn manual processes into reliable AI-enabled systems that can scale. WHAT WE LOOK FOR - Hands-on engineering ability, not just AI strategy or management experience. - Experience building AI agents, LLM apps, RAG systems, automation workflows, copilots or AI-enabled tools. - Strong coding ability in Python, TypeScript, JavaScript or similar practical stack. - Good judgement on what should be automated and what should not. - Able to ship working systems, test quality and improve reliability over time. - Fintech, banking, support automation, risk, KYC, fraud, CRM or operations automation experience is a strong plus. THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR - People who only want research projects with no production ownership. - Candidates who treat AI as demos instead of working systems. - Engineers who do not care about evaluation, reliability or user impact. - People who overclaim AI impact without evidence. - Builders who cannot work with product, ops and business teams. THE BAR We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system. LOCATION This role is remote, but candidates must be based in China. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in China. LANGUAGE English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required. INTERVIEW PROCESS Our process is designed to move fast: 1. Online assessment or practical task 2. Technical interview 3. CEO / final round For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.
